cards.title: Glossary
items: r3: the request's third revision row; here the checks and the solution half, one signature per half
Check: a one-line proof under a criterion, with an id such as SC3.1; the PO seat signs it, intake stores it per unit
Solution half: scope, out of scope, interfaces, constraints, units, sequencing, risks and cost; the engineer seat signs it
OPEN: a question the request cannot close alone; at ready none may stand, and an undecidable one parks the request
Prove red: the task that runs a unit's new tests before the code exists, expecting them to fail
Cursor: the one task in flight; the pane keeps its path open
Progress file: .sdlc/progress/<id>.yaml, ADR 0024's home for execution state; disposable, never a gate input
ADR 0024: the unit graph. ADR 0027: no committed plan. ADR 0029: the request format, checks above the line
herdr: the terminal multiplexer the pilot runs sessions in; its plugin wraps the notify command outside the kit
